# イラスト依頼文：脳10%神話（ChatGPT web、1チャット4枚まで、1行で送る）

共通：画風＝落ち着いた夜の紺色と、あたたかい金色のアクセント。絵画風の semi-realistic イラスト。**画像内に文字・数字・ロゴを入れない。実在人物の顔を描かない。**横長（16:9）。文字を重ねるので、全体に暗めで、細かい模様を入れすぎない。

保存名（assets/brain10/）：art_intro / art_study / art_clinic / art_scan / art_lamp / art_city / art_crowd / thumb_art

## チャット1
1. art_intro：Dark navy night illustration, a person seen from behind sitting at a desk by a window, above their head a faint glowing outline of a brain made of small golden light dots, calm and thoughtful mood, painterly semi-realistic style, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, wide 16:9 composition, dark overall with warm gold accents
2. art_study：Dark painterly illustration of an early 1900s scholar's study with no people, wooden desk, green-shaded lamp glowing warmly, stacks of papers and a fountain pen, bookshelves in shadow, quiet atmosphere, no readable text, no letters, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy and warm gold tones
3. art_clinic：Dark painterly illustration of a quiet hospital consultation room with no people, a wall light box showing abstract grayscale brain scan slices without any text or labels, soft cool blue light, a desk and a chair, calm mood, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy tones with a little warm gold
4. art_scan：Dark painterly illustration of a modern MRI scanner room with no people, an empty scanner bed, a control room window glowing in the background with an abstract colorful brain activity map on a monitor, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy tones with warm gold and teal accents
